senses.en: A particular feeling or quality in something.
senses.zh: 气氛；特征；某种意味。
senses.exampleEn: Her speech ended on a hopeful note.
senses.exampleZh: 她的演讲在充满希望的气氛中结束。

senses.en: A short piece of writing used as a reminder or message.
senses.zh: 笔记；简短的留言或记录。
senses.exampleEn: I left a note beside the dictionary.
senses.exampleZh: 我在词典旁留了一张便条。

senses.en: To notice something or record it in writing.
senses.zh: 注意到；记录。
senses.exampleEn: Please note the difference between the two meanings.
senses.exampleZh: 请注意这两个词义之间的区别。

senses.en: A single sound with a particular pitch in music.
senses.zh: 音符；单个乐音。
senses.exampleEn: The singer held the final note.
senses.exampleZh: 歌手拖长了最后一个音。

senses.en: Not popular or considered modern at the moment.
senses.zh: 不合时宜的；不流行的。
senses.exampleEn: Traditional paintings seemed unfashionable to young buyers.
senses.exampleZh: 在年轻买家看来，传统绘画似乎不合时宜。

senses.en: Not following the current style in clothing or appearance.
senses.zh: 穿着或外观过时的；不时髦的。
senses.exampleEn: His coat was unfashionable but very warm.
senses.exampleZh: 他的外套虽然不时髦，却很暖和。

senses.en: To be sold for a particular amount of money.
senses.zh: 售得；卖得某个价格。
senses.exampleEn: The small painting fetched a surprisingly high price.
senses.exampleZh: 这幅小画卖出了令人意外的高价。

senses.en: To go somewhere, get something, and bring it back.
senses.zh: 去取来；拿来。
senses.exampleEn: Could you fetch the book from my desk?
senses.exampleZh: 你能去我的书桌上把那本书拿来吗？

fetch.scene: 画作在拍卖中卖出高价

senses.en: A room or building where works of art are displayed.
senses.zh: 画廊；美术馆；陈列艺术作品的场所。
senses.exampleEn: The gallery displays paintings by local artists.
senses.exampleZh: 这家画廊展出了当地艺术家的画作。

senses.en: A raised area with seats above the main floor of a theatre.
senses.zh: 剧场的楼座；高层看台。
senses.exampleEn: We watched the performance from the gallery.
senses.exampleZh: 我们从剧场的楼座观看了演出。

gallery.scene: 走进画廊，欣赏墙上的画作

senses.en: A person who leads an auction and sells items to the highest bidder.
senses.zh: 拍卖师；主持拍卖并将物品卖给最高出价者的人。
senses.exampleEn: The auctioneer raised the hammer as the bidding ended.
senses.exampleZh: 竞价结束时，拍卖师举起了拍卖槌。

auctioneer.scene: 拍卖师在台前主持竞价

senses.en: Rooms where objects are sold at auction.
senses.zh: 拍卖场；拍卖室（saleroom 的复数）。
senses.exampleEn: Collectors filled the salerooms to bid for rare paintings.
senses.exampleZh: 收藏家挤满拍卖场，竞拍稀有画作。

salerooms.scene: 收藏家聚集的艺术品拍卖场

senses.en: An offer to pay a particular price for something at an auction.
senses.zh: 出价；拍卖时提出的价格。
senses.exampleEn: Her final bid was higher than anyone else's.
senses.exampleZh: 她最后的出价比其他任何人都高。

senses.en: To offer a price for something, especially at an auction.
senses.zh: 出价竞买；投标。
senses.exampleEn: Three collectors bid for the same painting.
senses.exampleZh: 三位收藏家竞价购买同一幅画。

senses.en: An attempt to achieve or obtain something.
senses.zh: 努力；争取某事的尝试。
senses.exampleEn: The city launched a bid to host the event.
senses.exampleZh: 这座城市开始争取主办这项活动。

bid.scene: 举起号牌，给出更高的价格

senses.en: Belonging to the present time.
senses.zh: 当代的；现代的。
senses.exampleEn: The museum has a large collection of contemporary art.
senses.exampleZh: 这家博物馆收藏了大量当代艺术作品。

senses.en: Living or happening during the same period.
senses.zh: 同时代的；发生在同一时期的。
senses.exampleEn: The two writers were contemporary with each other.
senses.exampleZh: 这两位作家生活在同一时代。

senses.en: A person who lived at the same time as someone else.
senses.zh: 同时代的人。
senses.exampleEn: His contemporaries admired his bold style.
senses.exampleZh: 与他同时代的人欣赏他大胆的风格。

contemporary.scene: 当代艺术展中的新颖作品

senses.en: A legal situation in which a person or business cannot pay its debts.
senses.zh: 破产；因无法偿还债务而进入的法律状态。
senses.exampleEn: Falling sales pushed the company toward bankruptcy.
senses.exampleZh: 销售额下降使这家公司濒临破产。

senses.en: A serious lack of useful ideas, values, or ability.
senses.zh: （思想、道德等的）彻底匮乏或败坏。
senses.exampleEn: The report exposed the moral bankruptcy of the decision.
senses.exampleZh: 这份报告揭露了这一决定在道德上的彻底败坏。

bankruptcy.scene: 关门的店铺与无法偿还的债务

senses.en: Growing or becoming active too quickly to remain stable.
senses.zh: （经济、市场等）过热的；发展过快而不稳定的。
senses.exampleEn: Prices rose rapidly in the overheated art market.
senses.exampleZh: 在过热的艺术品市场中，价格迅速上涨。

senses.en: Having become hotter than is safe or suitable.
senses.zh: 温度过高的；过热的。
senses.exampleEn: The overheated engine had to be switched off.
senses.exampleZh: 过热的发动机必须关闭。

overheated.scene: 温度表飙升，联想市场过热

senses.en: The strength that makes a developing activity continue or grow.
senses.zh: 势头；使活动持续或发展的动力。
senses.exampleEn: The campaign gained momentum after its first success.
senses.exampleZh: 首次取得成功后，这项活动的势头增强了。

senses.en: In physics, mass multiplied by velocity.
senses.zh: 动量；物体质量与速度的乘积。
senses.exampleEn: A moving truck has more momentum than a bicycle at the same speed.
senses.exampleZh: 在速度相同时，行驶中的卡车比自行车有更大的动量。

momentum.scene: 向前运动，积累持续前进的势头

senses.en: A firm promise that something will happen or be provided.
senses.zh: 保证；担保；明确的承诺。
senses.exampleEn: Past success is no guarantee of future profit.
senses.exampleZh: 过去的成功并不能保证未来获利。

senses.en: To promise that something will happen or be true.
senses.zh: 保证；担保某事会发生或属实。
senses.exampleEn: The seller guarantees that the painting is genuine.
senses.exampleZh: 卖家保证这幅画是真品。

senses.en: A promise to repair or replace a product if it fails within a stated period.
senses.zh: 保修承诺；保修凭证。
senses.exampleEn: The camera comes with a two-year guarantee.
senses.exampleZh: 这台相机附带两年的保修承诺。

guarantee.scene: 一份承诺或产品保修凭证

senses.en: In a way that makes something very difficult to understand.
senses.zh: 令人费解地；使人困惑地。
senses.exampleEn: Prices changed bewilderingly from one auction to the next.
senses.exampleZh: 价格在一场场拍卖之间变化得令人费解。

bewilderingly.scene: 复杂迷宫让人摸不着头脑

senses.en: A period when business or economic activity becomes weaker.
senses.zh: （商业、经济活动等的）下降；衰退。
senses.exampleEn: The economic downturn reduced demand for expensive art.
senses.exampleZh: 经济衰退降低了人们对昂贵艺术品的需求。

downturn.scene: 向下的曲线，表示经济活动减弱

senses.en: To think or believe that something is true.
senses.zh: 认为；估计。
senses.exampleEn: I reckon the market will recover slowly.
senses.exampleZh: 我认为市场会缓慢复苏。

senses.en: To calculate an amount or estimate a number.
senses.zh: 计算；估算数量。
senses.exampleEn: They reckoned the total cost at about a million dollars.
senses.exampleZh: 他们估算总费用约为一百万美元。

senses.en: To expect or depend on something; used as 'reckon on'.
senses.zh: 指望；预期（常用 reckon on）。
senses.exampleEn: We cannot reckon on prices staying this high.
senses.exampleZh: 我们不能指望价格一直维持这么高。

senses.en: An artist associated with Impressionism, a style that emphasizes light and immediate visual impressions.
senses.zh: 印象派画家；以光线和即时视觉印象为重点的艺术家。
senses.exampleEn: The impressionist painted the river in changing light.
senses.exampleZh: 这位印象派画家描绘了变化光线中的河流。

senses.en: A performer who imitates other people's voices and manner.
senses.zh: 模仿他人声音和举止的表演者。
senses.exampleEn: The impressionist copied the actor's voice perfectly.
senses.exampleZh: 这位模仿演员把那位演员的声音模仿得惟妙惟肖。

impressionist.scene: 印象派画作中的光线与色彩

senses.en: To cause something to exist or happen.
senses.zh: 产生；引起。
senses.exampleEn: The exhibition generated interest in new artists.
senses.exampleZh: 这场展览引起了人们对新艺术家的兴趣。

senses.en: To produce energy, especially electricity.
senses.zh: 产生能量；发电。
senses.exampleEn: Solar panels generate electricity during the day.
senses.exampleZh: 太阳能板在白天产生电力。

generate.scene: 太阳能板把阳光转化为电力

senses.en: Changing repeatedly rather than remaining steady.
senses.zh: 波动的；不稳定的（较少使用的形容词）。
senses.exampleEn: Fluctuant demand makes future sales hard to predict.
senses.exampleZh: 波动的需求使未来销量难以预测。

senses.en: A person's sense of self and personal importance.
senses.zh: 自我；个人对自身及自身重要性的认识。
senses.exampleEn: Winning the auction gave his ego a boost.
senses.exampleZh: 赢得这场拍卖增强了他的自我满足感。

senses.en: An excessively high opinion of one's own importance.
senses.zh: 自负；过强的自尊心。
senses.exampleEn: Her large ego made it difficult to accept criticism.
senses.exampleZh: 她过于自负，因此很难接受批评。

ego.scene: 镜中的自己，联想自我意识

senses.en: A sharp fall in prices, sales, or economic activity.
senses.zh: （价格、销量等的）暴跌；不景气；萧条。
senses.exampleEn: The slump in sales forced several galleries to close.
senses.exampleZh: 销量暴跌迫使几家画廊关闭。

senses.en: To fall sharply in amount or value.
senses.zh: 急剧下降；暴跌。
senses.exampleEn: Demand for expensive paintings slumped.
senses.exampleZh: 对昂贵画作的需求骤降。

senses.en: To fall or sit heavily with a bent, tired posture.
senses.zh: 无力地倒下；瘫坐。
senses.exampleEn: After the long journey, he slumped into a chair.
senses.exampleZh: 长途旅行后，他无力地瘫坐在椅子上。

slump.scene: 销量陡降，店铺陷入低迷

senses.en: A strong desire to have more money or possessions than one needs.
senses.zh: 贪婪；对金钱或财物的过度欲望。
senses.exampleEn: Greed led the buyer to take unnecessary risks.
senses.exampleZh: 贪婪使这位买家承担了不必要的风险。

senses.en: An excessive desire for food or another pleasure.
senses.zh: 贪吃；对某种享受的过度欲望。
senses.exampleEn: Out of greed, he took more cake than he could eat.
senses.exampleZh: 出于贪吃，他拿了超过自己能吃完的蛋糕。

greed.scene: 紧抓钱币，联想过度的欲望

senses.en: To take goods or messages to a person or place.
senses.zh: 输送；递送；运送。
senses.exampleEn: The gallery will deliver the painting to your home.
senses.exampleZh: 画廊会把这幅画送到你家。

senses.en: To give a speech or present something to an audience.
senses.zh: 发表演说；作报告。
senses.exampleEn: She delivered a speech about the value of art.
senses.exampleZh: 她发表了一场关于艺术价值的演讲。

senses.en: To produce the results that were expected or promised.
senses.zh: 实现；兑现预期或承诺的成果。
senses.exampleEn: The new plan failed to deliver the expected savings.
senses.exampleZh: 这项新计划未能实现预期的成本节约。

senses.en: To help a baby be born.
senses.zh: 接生；帮助婴儿出生。
senses.exampleEn: The doctor delivered the baby safely.
senses.exampleZh: 医生安全地接生了这个婴儿。

deliver.scene: 快递员把包裹送到门口

senses.en: Strong public disagreement about a particular issue.
senses.zh: 争议；围绕某一问题的公开分歧。
senses.exampleEn: The sale of the painting caused a public controversy.
senses.exampleZh: 这幅画的出售引发了一场公众争议。

controversy.scene: 人们围绕同一个问题持不同意见

senses.en: To speak to a person or group, often formally.
senses.zh: 发表演说；向某人或某群体讲话。
senses.exampleEn: The sociologist addressed a large gathering of students.
senses.exampleZh: 这位社会学家向一大群学生发表了演说。

senses.en: To give attention to a problem and try to deal with it.
senses.zh: 着手解决；处理；应对问题。
senses.exampleEn: The report addresses the causes of social inequality.
senses.exampleZh: 这份报告探讨并着手处理社会不平等的成因。

senses.en: Details of where a person lives or an organization is located.
senses.zh: 地址；某人居住或某机构所在的位置。
senses.exampleEn: Write your address on the registration form.
senses.exampleZh: 请在登记表上写下你的地址。

senses.en: To write the destination on a letter or package.
senses.zh: 在信件或包裹上写收件地址。
senses.exampleEn: She addressed the envelope to her professor.
senses.exampleZh: 她在信封上写了教授的收件地址。

address.scene: 讲者面向听众发表演说

senses.en: A person who studies society, social relationships, and human behavior in groups.
senses.zh: 社会学家；研究社会、社会关系及群体行为的人。
senses.exampleEn: The sociologist studied how city life changes family relationships.
senses.exampleZh: 这位社会学家研究城市生活如何改变家庭关系。

sociologist.scene: 研究者观察社会中的人际关系

senses.en: A group of people meeting for a particular purpose.
senses.zh: 聚会；集会；为某种目的聚在一起的人群。
senses.exampleEn: The lecture began with a small gathering of neighbors.
senses.exampleZh: 这场讲座开始时只有一小群邻居参加。

senses.en: The act of bringing information or things together.
senses.zh: 收集；汇集。
senses.exampleEn: The gathering of evidence took several weeks.
senses.exampleZh: 证据收集花了好几个星期。

senses.en: Almost the same as the stated thing, although not officially or completely so.
senses.zh: 实际上的；几乎等同于某事的。
senses.exampleEn: The long silence brought the discussion to a virtual end.
senses.exampleZh: 长时间的沉默使这场讨论实际上结束了。

senses.en: Created or experienced through computers rather than in a physical place.
senses.zh: 虚拟的；通过计算机实现或体验的。
senses.exampleEn: We explored the museum through a virtual tour.
senses.exampleZh: 我们通过虚拟导览参观了这家博物馆。

virtual.scene: 虚拟现实设备创造数字体验

senses.en: Located in or related to residential areas outside a city's center.
senses.zh: 郊区的；与城市中心外围住宅区有关的。
senses.exampleEn: They moved to a quiet suburban neighborhood.
senses.exampleZh: 他们搬到了一个安静的郊区社区。

suburban.scene: 城市外围安静的住宅街区

senses.en: A disease outbreak that affects many people in a community within a short time.
senses.zh: 流行病；某种疾病在短时间内于一个群体中广泛传播。
senses.exampleEn: The epidemic forced several schools to close temporarily.
senses.exampleZh: 这场流行病迫使几所学校暂时关闭。

senses.en: A rapid, widespread increase in an undesirable activity or condition.
senses.zh: 某种不良现象的迅速蔓延。
senses.exampleEn: The article describes an epidemic of loneliness.
senses.exampleZh: 这篇文章描述了孤独感的广泛蔓延。

epidemic.scene: 公共卫生措施应对疾病传播

senses.en: Often talking a lot or enjoying conversation.
senses.zh: 健谈的；爱说话的。
senses.exampleEn: Our talkative neighbor always has a story to share.
senses.exampleZh: 我们那位健谈的邻居总有故事要分享。

senses.en: Real or clear enough to be shown or proved.
senses.zh: 确凿的；实在的；可以明确证明的。
senses.exampleEn: The study provides tangible evidence of improvement.
senses.exampleZh: 这项研究提供了改进的确凿证据。

senses.en: Having a physical form that can be touched.
senses.zh: 有形的；可以触摸的。
senses.exampleEn: A printed photograph is a tangible reminder of the trip.
senses.exampleZh: 一张打印出来的照片是这次旅行的有形纪念。

tangible.scene: 手里可触摸的照片与实在的证据

senses.en: A short, often amusing account of something that happened to a person.
senses.zh: 轶事；关于某人经历的简短而常有趣的故事。
senses.exampleEn: She opened her talk with an anecdote about her first job.
senses.exampleZh: 她用一则关于自己第一份工作的轶事作为演讲开场。

anecdote.scene: 用一个有趣的小故事开启话题

senses.en: An unfair difference in the way people are treated or in what they receive.
senses.zh: 不平等；待遇或资源分配上的不公平。
senses.exampleEn: The report highlights inequity in access to education.
senses.exampleZh: 这份报告强调了获得教育机会方面的不平等。

inequity.scene: 倾斜的天平象征不公平

senses.en: To express an opinion about something.
senses.zh: 发表意见；评论。
senses.exampleEn: The researcher commented on the survey results.
senses.exampleZh: 研究者对调查结果发表了意见。

senses.en: A spoken or written statement expressing an opinion.
senses.zh: 评论；表达意见的话语或文字。
senses.exampleEn: Her comment started a lively discussion.
senses.exampleZh: 她的评论引发了一场热烈的讨论。

senses.en: To go somewhere with another person.
senses.zh: 陪伴；陪同某人前往某处。
senses.exampleEn: I accompanied my friend to the community meeting.
senses.exampleZh: 我陪朋友去参加了社区会议。

senses.en: To happen or appear together with something else.
senses.zh: 伴随；与某事同时发生或出现。
senses.exampleEn: Clear examples accompany each explanation.
senses.exampleZh: 每条解释都配有清晰的例子。

senses.en: To play music while another person sings or plays the main part.
senses.zh: 为演唱或演奏伴奏。
senses.exampleEn: A pianist accompanied the singer.
senses.exampleZh: 一位钢琴家为歌手伴奏。

senses.en: To communicate or show something by moving your hands or body.
senses.zh: 做手势；用身体动作示意。
senses.exampleEn: She gestured toward the empty seat.
senses.exampleZh: 她朝那个空座位做了个手势。

senses.en: A movement of the hands or body that expresses an idea or feeling.
senses.zh: 手势；表达想法或感受的身体动作。
senses.exampleEn: He welcomed us with a friendly gesture.
senses.exampleZh: 他用一个友好的手势欢迎我们。

senses.en: An action intended to show a particular attitude.
senses.zh: 表示某种态度的举动。
senses.exampleEn: The gift was a gesture of thanks.
senses.exampleZh: 这份礼物是表达感谢的举动。

gesture.scene: 用一个手势指向空座位

senses.en: A portion of something that belongs to or is expected from one person.
senses.zh: 一份；某人应得或应承担的部分。
senses.exampleEn: Everyone should do their share of the work.
senses.exampleZh: 每个人都应该完成自己那份工作。

senses.en: To use or enjoy something together with another person.
senses.zh: 分享；共同使用或享受。
senses.exampleEn: We shared a meal after the meeting.
senses.exampleZh: 会议结束后，我们一起吃了顿饭。

senses.en: One of the equal parts of a company's ownership that people can buy.
senses.zh: 股份；公司所有权中可买卖的一份。
senses.exampleEn: She bought shares in a technology company.
senses.exampleZh: 她购买了一家科技公司的股份。

share.scene: 共享一顿饭，各自承担一份工作

senses.en: Unable to understand something and wanting an explanation.
senses.zh: 困惑的；因不理解而感到迷惑的。
senses.exampleEn: The unexpected result left the researcher puzzled.
senses.exampleZh: 这个意外的结果让研究者感到困惑。

puzzled.scene: 面对意外结果，疑惑地思考

senses.en: To express a comment, especially about something one has noticed.
senses.zh: 评论；就注意到的事情发表看法。
senses.exampleEn: She observed that the meeting had lasted too long.
senses.exampleZh: 她评论说，这场会议持续得太久了。

senses.en: To watch or notice something carefully.
senses.zh: 观察；仔细观看或注意。
senses.exampleEn: The scientist observed how the birds built their nests.
senses.exampleZh: 科学家观察了鸟类如何筑巢。

senses.en: To follow a rule, custom, or particular occasion.
senses.zh: 遵守规则；奉行习俗；庆祝或纪念某个日子。
senses.exampleEn: All visitors must observe the safety rules.
senses.exampleZh: 所有访客都必须遵守安全规定。

senses.en: An event that forms one part of a longer experience or series of events.
senses.zh: 插曲；一段经历或一连串事件中的一个部分。
senses.exampleEn: The disagreement was only a brief episode in their friendship.
senses.exampleZh: 这次分歧只是他们友谊中的一段短暂插曲。

senses.en: One separate part of a television or radio series.
senses.zh: 电视或广播系列节目中的一集。
senses.exampleEn: We watched the final episode together.
senses.exampleZh: 我们一起观看了最后一集。

senses.en: A belief or hope that something will happen in a particular way.
senses.zh: 期望；对某事会如何发生的希望或预期。
senses.exampleEn: The course exceeded my expectations.
senses.exampleZh: 这门课程超出了我的预期。

senses.en: A standard that people believe someone should meet.
senses.zh: 要求；人们认为某人应该达到的标准。
senses.exampleEn: The teacher clearly explained her expectations.
senses.exampleZh: 老师清楚地说明了她的要求。

senses.en: To make an idea clear and definite, or to become clear and definite.
senses.zh: 使明确化；使具体化；变得清晰明确。
senses.exampleEn: The discussion helped crystallize our plans.
senses.exampleZh: 这场讨论帮助我们明确了计划。

senses.en: To form crystals or cause a substance to form crystals.
senses.zh: 结晶；使物质形成晶体。
senses.exampleEn: Sugar crystallized as the solution cooled.
senses.exampleZh: 溶液冷却时，糖结晶了。

crystallize.scene: 结晶成形，联想想法逐渐清晰

senses.en: To speak or act officially for a person or group.
senses.zh: 代表；正式替某人或某群体发言或行动。
senses.exampleEn: She will represent the students at the meeting.
senses.exampleZh: 她将在会议上代表学生。

senses.en: To stand for or be a symbol of something.
senses.zh: 象征；表示。
senses.exampleEn: The blue line represents the river on the map.
senses.exampleZh: 地图上的蓝线表示河流。

senses.en: To show or describe something in a particular way.
senses.zh: 描绘；表现；描述。
senses.exampleEn: The painting represents everyday life in the village.
senses.exampleZh: 这幅画描绘了村庄的日常生活。

represent.scene: 学生代表在会议中发言

senses.en: A situation in which the result is strikingly different from what one would expect.
senses.zh: 具有讽刺意味的情况；结果与预期形成鲜明反差。
senses.exampleEn: The irony is that the time-saving tool made the task slower.
senses.exampleZh: 讽刺的是，这个节省时间的工具反而让任务完成得更慢。

senses.en: The use of words that suggest the opposite of their literal meaning.
senses.zh: 反语；用字面上相反的说法表达真实意思。
senses.exampleEn: Calling the rainy day perfect was an example of irony.
senses.exampleZh: 把那个雨天称为完美的一天，就是使用反语的例子。

irony.scene: 期待晴天，结果却遇到大雨

senses.en: A serious situation that requires urgent decisions or action.
senses.zh: 危机；需要紧急决策或行动的严重局面。
senses.exampleEn: The water shortage has become a crisis.
senses.exampleZh: 缺水已经演变成了一场危机。

senses.en: A very difficult stage in a person's life.
senses.zh: 人生中的重大困境或艰难阶段。
senses.exampleEn: Friends helped him through a personal crisis.
senses.exampleZh: 朋友们帮助他渡过了个人生活中的危机。

crisis.scene: 缺水局面需要紧急应对

senses.en: To cause serious damage or suffering; often used with 'havoc'.
senses.zh: 造成严重破坏或痛苦；常与 havoc 连用。
senses.exampleEn: The storm wreaked havoc on the coastal roads.
senses.exampleZh: 这场风暴对沿海道路造成了严重破坏。

senses.en: Matching a common, simplified idea about a type of person or thing.
senses.zh: 符合刻板印象的；呈现常见而简化的典型形象的。
senses.exampleEn: The film avoids stereotypical images of suburban life.
senses.exampleZh: 这部电影避免使用关于郊区生活的刻板形象。

stereotypical.scene: 熟悉的典型形象可能只是刻板印象

senses.en: Widespread damage, disorder, or disruption.
senses.zh: 严重破坏；混乱；大范围的扰乱。
senses.exampleEn: A sudden power failure caused havoc at the station.
senses.exampleZh: 突然停电使车站陷入严重混乱。

senses.en: A place and the things happening there at a particular time.
senses.zh: 场景；某个地点及当时发生的事情。
senses.exampleEn: The scene outside the station was unusually quiet.
senses.exampleZh: 车站外的场景异常安静。

senses.en: One part of a play or film that takes place in one setting.
senses.zh: 戏剧或电影中的一场；一个片段。
senses.exampleEn: The opening scene introduces the main character.
senses.exampleZh: 开场那一幕介绍了主角。

senses.en: The place where an event, especially a crime or accident, happened.
senses.zh: 事件发生地点；犯罪或事故现场。
senses.exampleEn: Police quickly arrived at the scene of the accident.
senses.exampleZh: 警方很快到达了事故现场。

senses.en: Operating almost automatically, while still requiring some human input.
senses.zh: 准自动的；基本自动运行但仍需部分人工参与的。
senses.exampleEn: The quasi-automatic system still needs a person to approve each transfer.
senses.exampleZh: 这套准自动系统仍需要人工批准每次转账。

quasi-automatic.scene: 机器自动运行，关键步骤由人确认

senses.en: Improving or presenting a favorable view of one's own qualities or worth.
senses.zh: 自我提升的；提升或美化对自身品质、价值的看法的。
senses.exampleEn: Self-enhancing beliefs can make people overlook their weaknesses.
senses.exampleZh: 自我拔高的想法可能使人忽视自己的弱点。

self-enhancing.scene: 自我评价与镜中的形象

senses.en: The tendency or effort to see oneself in a more favorable way.
senses.zh: 自我强化；自我拔高；倾向于更积极地看待自己。
senses.exampleEn: The study examined self-enhancement in personal judgments.
senses.exampleZh: 这项研究考察了个人判断中的自我拔高倾向。

self-enhancement.scene: 个人判断中的积极自我评价

senses.en: People who do not have children.
senses.zh: 无子女者；没有孩子的人。
senses.exampleEn: The survey compared the daily routines of parents and nonparents.
senses.exampleZh: 这项调查比较了父母和无子女者的日常安排。

nonparents.scene: 比较不同人群的日常生活

senses.en: The spread of an effect from one area or situation into another.
senses.zh: 渗透；某种影响从一个领域扩散到另一个领域。
senses.exampleEn: There was bleed-over from work stress into family life.
senses.exampleZh: 工作压力的影响渗透到了家庭生活中。

bleed-over.scene: 颜色渗开，联想影响向外扩散

senses.en: Organized into clear parts that fit together effectively.
senses.zh: 结构良好的；条理清晰且各部分衔接合理的。
senses.exampleEn: A well-structured report makes the argument easier to follow.
senses.exampleZh: 一份结构良好的报告使论证更容易理解。

well-structured.scene: 清晰的大纲让内容有条理

senses.en: Using rewards or other benefits to encourage particular actions.
senses.zh: 基于激励的；通过奖励或好处鼓励特定行为的。
senses.exampleEn: The incentive-based program rewards households that save energy.
senses.exampleZh: 这项激励计划奖励节约能源的家庭。

incentive-based.scene: 奖励鼓励人们采取行动

senses.en: A tendency to behave in ways that help or benefit other people.
senses.zh: 亲社会性；倾向于帮助他人或让他人受益的行为特征。
senses.exampleEn: The researchers measured prosociality through acts of cooperation.
senses.exampleZh: 研究者通过合作行为衡量亲社会性。

senses.en: A small number of people or things; the usual pattern is 'a handful of' plus a plural noun.
senses.zh: 少数人或物；常见结构为 a handful of 加复数名词。
senses.exampleEn: Only a handful of students stayed after the lecture.
senses.exampleZh: 讲座结束后，只有少数学生留了下来。

senses.en: Economic activities and livelihoods in countryside areas.
senses.zh: 乡村经济；农村地区的经济活动与生计。
senses.exampleEn: Small farms remain important to the rural economy.
senses.exampleZh: 小型农场对乡村经济仍然很重要。

senses.en: A plan to balance greenhouse gas emissions with equivalent removals.
senses.zh: 净零排放战略；使温室气体排放量与移除量达到平衡的计划。
senses.exampleEn: The company's net-zero strategy includes cutting energy use.
senses.exampleZh: 公司的净零排放战略包括减少能源使用。

net-zero strategy.scene: 减少排放与增加碳移除

senses.en: Restoring an area so that natural processes and wildlife can recover.
senses.zh: 再野化；恢复一个地区的自然过程与野生生物。
senses.exampleEn: Rewilding has brought native plants back to the valley.
senses.exampleZh: 再野化使本地植物重新回到了这个山谷。

rewilding.scene: 让本地植物和野生动物重新繁盛

senses.en: Many different types of something; often used as 'a wide range of'.
senses.zh: 范围广泛的；各种各样的；常用 a wide range of。
senses.exampleEn: The library offers a wide range of books.
senses.exampleZh: 这家图书馆提供各种各样的书籍。

wide range of.scene: 书架上种类丰富的图书

senses.en: Shared rules or expectations about how a service should be provided.
senses.zh: 服务规范；对服务提供方式的共同规则或期待。
senses.exampleEn: Clear service norms help staff respond consistently.
senses.exampleZh: 清晰的服务规范有助于员工以一致的方式回应顾客。

service norms.scene: 工作人员遵循共同的服务标准

senses.en: Electronic equipment used to make or accept payments.
senses.zh: 数字支付设备；用于进行或接收电子支付的设备。
senses.exampleEn: Digital payment devices are now common in small shops.
senses.exampleZh: 数字支付设备如今在小商店里很常见。

senses.en: Messages or questions asking customers to leave a gratuity.
senses.zh: 索要小费的提示或请求。
senses.exampleEn: Tip requests appeared on the screen before the payment was complete.
senses.exampleZh: 付款完成之前，屏幕上就出现了索要小费的提示。

tip requests.scene: 结账屏幕出现小费请求

senses.en: Increasing to higher and higher levels.
senses.zh: 越来越高的；持续升高的。
senses.exampleEn: Ever-higher prices put pressure on household budgets.
senses.exampleZh: 越来越高的价格给家庭预算带来压力。

senses.en: To be separated or no longer connected; often followed by 'from'.
senses.zh: 被分离；与某事脱节；常接 from。
senses.exampleEn: The decision should not be dissociated from its social context.
senses.exampleZh: 这一决定不应该脱离其社会背景来理解。

be dissociated.scene: 彼此分离、失去联系的拼图

senses.en: To have a particular purpose or planned effect; followed by a verb.
senses.zh: 旨在；目的是；后接动词表示计划实现的作用。
senses.exampleEn: The new policy is intended to reduce waiting times.
senses.exampleZh: 这项新政策旨在减少等待时间。

senses.en: To be listed among people waiting for a place, service, or treatment.
senses.zh: 在等候名单上；排队等待名额、服务或治疗。
senses.exampleEn: Many patients are on waitlists for routine surgery.
senses.exampleZh: 许多患者在等候名单上等待常规手术。

senses.en: To choose to take a particular action; 'do' stands for the action verb.
senses.zh: 选择做某事；do 表示随后替换的动作动词。
senses.exampleEn: Some residents opt to travel by bus.
senses.exampleZh: 一些居民选择乘公交车出行。

senses.en: Healthcare provided by privately run organizations or practitioners.
senses.zh: 私立医疗服务；由私人经营的机构或医务人员提供的医疗服务。
senses.exampleEn: Private medical services may offer shorter waiting times.
senses.exampleZh: 私立医疗服务可能提供较短的等待时间。

senses.en: Practiced carefully before being performed.
senses.zh: 经过充分排练的；事先练习熟练的。
senses.exampleEn: The students gave a well rehearsed performance.
senses.exampleZh: 学生们呈现了一场经过充分排练的演出。

senses.en: Repeated or discussed so often that it has become familiar.
senses.zh: 被反复讨论而令人熟悉的；老生常谈的。
senses.exampleEn: The objections to the plan were already well rehearsed.
senses.exampleZh: 对这项计划的反对意见早已是老生常谈。

well rehearsed.scene: 反复排练，熟悉每个细节

senses.en: To feel worried or be affected by a problem.
senses.zh: 感到困扰；受到某种问题的影响。
senses.exampleEn: Residents were troubled by the rising cost of care.
senses.exampleZh: 居民们受到护理费用上涨的困扰。

senses.en: Support that helps people manage daily life when they need assistance.
senses.zh: 社会护理；为日常生活需要帮助的人提供的支持服务。
senses.exampleEn: Social care can help older people live independently.
senses.exampleZh: 社会护理可以帮助老年人独立生活。

social care.scene: 护理人员帮助长者生活

senses.en: A research organization that develops ideas for changing policies or institutions.
senses.zh: 改革智库；研究并提出政策或制度改革方案的机构。
senses.exampleEn: A reform think tank published proposals for better public services.
senses.exampleZh: 一家改革智库发布了改善公共服务的建议。

reform think tank.scene: 研究人员讨论政策改革方案

senses.en: Organized mainly around hospitals and their role in care.
senses.zh: 以医院为中心的；主要围绕医院组织医疗服务的。
senses.exampleEn: The report calls for a less hospital-centric model of care.
senses.exampleZh: 这份报告呼吁减少护理模式对医院的集中依赖。

hospital-centric.scene: 医院处于医疗体系的中心

senses.en: A phrase used to introduce an approximate calculation or judgment.
senses.zh: 据估计；用于引出大致的计算结果或判断。
senses.exampleEn: It is estimated that the repairs will take two weeks.
senses.exampleZh: 据估计，维修将需要两周时间。

senses.en: A very large amount of money paid for something.
senses.zh: 高昂的价格或费用。
senses.exampleEn: The family paid a hefty price for private treatment.
senses.exampleZh: 这个家庭为私立医疗支付了高昂的费用。

senses.en: Plans for preparing for and responding to dangerously hot weather.
senses.zh: 高温行动计划；应对危险高温天气的准备和行动方案。
senses.exampleEn: Cities updated their heat action plans before summer.
senses.exampleZh: 各城市在夏季到来之前更新了高温行动计划。

heat action plans.scene: 高温天气下的避暑与应对

senses.en: Workers who do physical work on building sites.
senses.zh: 建筑工人；在施工现场从事体力劳动的人员。
senses.exampleEn: Construction laborers took extra breaks during the heatwave.
senses.exampleZh: 热浪期间，建筑工人增加了休息次数。

senses.en: An urgent alert about a serious danger or approaching threat.
senses.zh: 紧急预警；关于严重危险或临近威胁的紧急提示。
senses.exampleEn: The emergency warning told residents to leave the area.
senses.exampleZh: 紧急预警通知居民撤离该区域。

emergency warning.scene: 警报提醒人们立即应对

senses.en: The level at which a condition causes an action or response to begin.
senses.zh: 触发阈值；达到后会启动某种行动或反应的临界水平。
senses.exampleEn: The alert begins when the temperature reaches the triggering threshold.
senses.exampleZh: 温度达到触发阈值时，预警就会启动。

triggering threshold.scene: 数值达到临界点，系统启动预警

senses.en: An unpaved path formed or marked by repeated footsteps.
senses.zh: 踩踏出来的土路；反复走动形成的无铺装小径。
senses.exampleEn: A trodden dirt track led across the field.
senses.exampleZh: 一条踩踏出来的土路穿过田野。

trodden dirt track.scene: 脚步在田间走出一条小路

senses.en: To divide lawns into two parts by crossing through them.
senses.zh: 穿过草坪并将其分成两部分。
senses.exampleEn: Narrow paths bisect lawns in the park.
senses.exampleZh: 狭窄的小路穿过公园的草坪，将其分成两部分。

senses.en: To go on to take the next action; 'do' stands for the action verb.
senses.zh: 接着做某事；继续进行下一步行动。
senses.exampleEn: After reading the instructions, she proceeded to fill in the form.
senses.exampleZh: 读完说明后，她接着填写了表格。

proceed to do.scene: 读完说明，接着完成下一步

senses.en: A document or screen of information that can be viewed on a website.
senses.zh: 网页；网站上可以浏览的一页信息。
senses.exampleEn: The web-page explains how to join the course.
senses.exampleZh: 这个网页说明了如何加入课程。

senses.en: To give much of one's time, effort, or attention to something.
senses.zh: 致力于；把大量时间、精力或注意力投入某事。
senses.exampleEn: The team is devoted to protecting local wildlife.
senses.exampleZh: 这个团队致力于保护当地野生生物。

be devoted to.scene: 持续投入精力保护野生生物

senses.en: To be decorated with something that adds beauty.
senses.zh: 装饰有；用增添美感的事物进行装饰。
senses.exampleEn: The entrance is adorned with flowers.
senses.exampleZh: 入口装饰着鲜花。

senses.en: Shaped or guided mainly by users' needs, actions, or feedback.
senses.zh: 用户驱动的；主要由用户需求、行为或反馈推动的。
senses.exampleEn: The user-driven design process began with interviews.
senses.exampleZh: 用户驱动的设计流程从访谈开始。

user-driven.scene: 用户反馈引导设计改进

senses.en: A system that arranges or organizes things using a grid.
senses.zh: 网格系统；用网格安排或组织事物的系统。
senses.exampleEn: The map uses a grid-based system to mark locations.
senses.exampleZh: 这张地图使用网格系统标记位置。

senses.en: To be used in a particular situation or for a particular purpose.
senses.zh: 被应用；被用于某种情境或目的。
senses.exampleEn: The method can be applied to other subjects.
senses.exampleZh: 这种方法可以被用于其他学科。

be applied.scene: 把方法用于新的实际情境

senses.en: A healthy and generally positive state of mind and emotional life.
senses.zh: 心理健康；总体良好的心理与情绪状态。
senses.exampleEn: Regular exercise can support mental well-being.
senses.exampleZh: 规律运动可以促进心理健康。

mental well-being.scene: 在自然中散步，照顾心理状态

senses.en: A characteristic that two or more people or things have in common.
senses.zh: 共同特征；两个或多个对象共有的特点。
senses.exampleEn: Curiosity is a shared trait among the researchers.
senses.exampleZh: 好奇心是这些研究者共有的特征。

shared trait.scene: 不同人身上的共同特点

senses.en: An administrative unit responsible for cultural matters.
senses.zh: 文化部门；负责文化事务的行政单位。
senses.exampleEn: The culture department supports local exhibitions.
senses.exampleZh: 文化部门支持当地的展览活动。

culture department.scene: 文化部门支持城市展览

senses.en: An assessment carried out without control by those being assessed.
senses.zh: 独立评估；由不受被评估方控制的人员开展的审查。
senses.exampleEn: An independent review examined the project's results.
senses.exampleZh: 一项独立评估审查了这个项目的成果。

independent review.scene: 独立人员审查项目成果

senses.en: A place where many people are busy doing different things.
senses.zh: 忙碌的场所；许多人同时忙于各种活动的地方。
senses.exampleEn: The library became a hive of activity before the exams.
senses.exampleZh: 考试之前，图书馆成了一个忙碌的场所。

hive of activity.scene: 图书馆里大家都在忙碌学习

senses.en: To value or recognize someone or something less than they deserve.
senses.zh: 未充分认可；低估应有的价值或贡献。
senses.exampleEn: People often underappreciate the work of local volunteers.
senses.exampleZh: 人们常常没有充分认可当地志愿者的工作。

underappreciate.scene: 值得更多认可的志愿者工作

senses.en: To estimate an amount as a particular number.
senses.zh: 将某一数量估算为；后接估计数值。
senses.exampleEn: Experts put the cost at around two million dollars.
senses.exampleZh: 专家将费用估算为大约两百万美元。

senses.en: The most important causes or explanations for something.
senses.zh: 主要原因；最重要的成因或解释。
senses.exampleEn: Cost and convenience were the primary reasons for the change.
senses.exampleZh: 成本和便利性是这次改变的主要原因。

primary reasons.scene: 找出影响决定的主要原因

senses.en: The lively and diverse character of a place's cultural life.
senses.zh: 文化活力；一个地方文化生活的活跃和多样性。
senses.exampleEn: Local festivals add to the city's cultural vibrancy.
senses.exampleZh: 当地节庆活动增强了这座城市的文化活力。

cultural vibrancy.scene: 节庆表演让城市充满文化活力

senses.en: To make a strong effort to take an action or achieve a goal.
senses.zh: 努力做某事；为行动或目标付出很大努力。
senses.exampleEn: The students strive to improve their reading skills.
senses.exampleZh: 学生们努力提高自己的阅读能力。

senses.en: To give something a pink or rosy color.
senses.zh: 染上玫瑰色；使呈粉红色。
senses.exampleEn: The evening light rose-tinted the clouds.
senses.exampleZh: 傍晚的光线把云朵染成了玫瑰色。

senses.en: To make something appear better or more pleasant than it really is.
senses.zh: 粉饰；美化；把事物看得比实际更美好。
senses.exampleEn: Nostalgia can rose-tint our memories of the past.
senses.exampleZh: 怀旧之情会美化我们对过去的记忆。

rose-tint.scene: 玫瑰色的晚霞，联想美化回忆

senses.en: To encourage or cause someone to take a particular action.
senses.zh: 提示或促使某人做某事。
senses.exampleEn: The reminder prompted me to finish the form.
senses.exampleZh: 这条提醒促使我填完了表格。

senses.en: To be connected with something to a smaller degree.
senses.zh: 与某事的关联更小；与某事关系较少。
senses.exampleEn: The result may have less to do with talent than with practice.
senses.exampleZh: 这个结果可能更多地与练习有关，而不是与天赋有关。

have less to do with.scene: 比较不同因素与结果的联系

senses.en: To reduce the difficulty of taking a particular action.
senses.zh: 使做某事变得更容易。
senses.exampleEn: Clear examples make it easier to understand the rules.
senses.exampleZh: 清晰的例子使理解规则变得更容易。

make it easier to do sth..scene: 清晰的步骤让任务更容易

senses.en: The publicly funded healthcare service in the United Kingdom.
senses.zh: 英国国民医疗服务体系；由公共资金支持的医疗服务体系。
senses.exampleEn: The National Health Service provides a wide range of medical care.
senses.exampleZh: 英国国民医疗服务体系提供广泛的医疗服务。

senses.en: To make a responsibility, difficulty, or cost less heavy or demanding.
senses.zh: 减轻某种责任、困难或费用带来的负担。
senses.exampleEn: The new service helps lighten the burden of caring for relatives.
senses.exampleZh: 这项新服务有助于减轻照顾亲属的负担。

lighten the burden of.scene: 分担照护任务，减轻负担

senses.en: To cause something to remain under a high level of strain or demand.
senses.zh: 使某事物持续承受巨大压力或负荷。
senses.exampleEn: Extreme heat keeps the power system under great pressure.
senses.exampleZh: 极端高温使电力系统持续承受巨大压力。
surfaceForms: keeps the power system under great pressure

keep sth. under great pressure.scene: 高温让电力系统承受压力

senses.en: To be strengthened or supported by adding something useful.
senses.zh: 通过增加有用的事物得到加强或支持；原词汇表语境译为配备有。
senses.exampleEn: The plan was bolstered with extra funding.
senses.exampleZh: 这项计划通过额外资金得到了加强。

be bolstered with.scene: 额外资源为计划提供支持

senses.en: To come into one's thoughts immediately or unexpectedly.
senses.zh: 立即被想到；突然浮现在脑海中。
senses.exampleEn: Her name was the first to spring to mind.
senses.exampleZh: 她的名字是第一个浮现在我脑海中的名字。

spring to mind.scene: 一个想法突然出现在脑海中

senses.en: In both directions along or throughout a place.
senses.zh: 来回；到处；遍及某一地方。
senses.exampleEn: Small clinics operate up and down the country.
senses.exampleZh: 小型诊所遍布全国各地。

senses.en: Alternately in a higher and a lower direction or position.
senses.zh: 上下地；交替向上和向下。
senses.exampleEn: The child jumped up and down with excitement.
senses.exampleZh: 孩子兴奋地上下跳跃。

up and down.scene: 各地都有活动，或上下运动

senses.en: To reveal information that was supposed to remain secret.
senses.zh: 泄露秘密；说漏嘴。
senses.exampleEn: Please don't spill the beans about the surprise party.
senses.exampleZh: 请不要说漏嘴，透露惊喜派对的秘密。

spill the beans.scene: 一不小心把秘密说了出来

senses.en: With regard to a particular aspect or way of considering something.
senses.zh: 在某个方面；从某种角度来看。
senses.exampleEn: The bus is better in terms of cost.
senses.exampleZh: 从费用的角度来看，公交车更合适。

in terms of.scene: 从费用这个角度比较选择

senses.en: During the time before another event happens.
senses.zh: 在此期间；与此同时；等待另一件事发生的这段时间。
senses.exampleEn: The repairs will take a week; in the meantime, use the other room.
senses.exampleZh: 维修需要一周；在此期间，请使用另一个房间。

in the meantime.scene: 等待下一件事发生的这段时间

senses.en: A person who attends a festival; a shortened form used in the source vocabulary list.
senses.zh: 节庆活动参与者；原词汇表使用的缩略词形。
senses.exampleEn: The festgoer arrived early to enjoy the music.
senses.exampleZh: 这位节庆活动参与者早早到达，准备欣赏音乐。

festgoer.scene: 参加节庆音乐活动的人群

senses.en: To improve something until it is as good as possible.
senses.zh: 完善；使尽可能完美。
senses.exampleEn: She practiced every day to perfect her technique.
senses.exampleZh: 她每天练习，以完善自己的技术。

senses.en: Good at understanding situations and making practical decisions.
senses.zh: 精明的；善于判断的。
senses.exampleEn: A shrewd buyer compares prices before making a decision.
senses.exampleZh: 精明的买家会在作决定前比较价格。

senses.en: A group of people who decide the facts of a case in court.
senses.zh: 陪审团；在法庭上裁定案件事实的一组人。
senses.exampleEn: The jury listened carefully to the evidence.
senses.exampleZh: 陪审团认真听取了证据。

senses.en: To officially forbid an action.
senses.zh: 正式禁止某种行为。
senses.exampleEn: The rules prohibit smoking inside the building.
senses.exampleZh: 规定禁止在楼内吸烟。

senses.en: Comments that express disapproval or point out faults.
senses.zh: 批评；指出缺点或表示不赞同的意见。
senses.exampleEn: The plan faced criticism because it ignored local needs.
senses.exampleZh: 这项计划因忽视当地需求而受到批评。

senses.en: Money paid for work, loss, or injury.
senses.zh: 报酬；对劳动、损失或伤害的金钱补偿。
senses.exampleEn: The company offered compensation for the extra hours of work.
senses.exampleZh: 公司为额外的工作时间提供了报酬。

senses.en: A period when economic activity falls.
senses.zh: 经济衰退；经济活动下降的时期。
senses.exampleEn: Many small businesses closed during the recession.
senses.exampleZh: 许多小企业在经济衰退期间倒闭了。

senses.en: The act of bringing goods or messages to someone.
senses.zh: 投递；递送货物或信息。
senses.exampleEn: The delivery of fresh food takes place every morning.
senses.exampleZh: 新鲜食品每天早晨配送。

senses.en: The condition of being successful and having enough money.
senses.zh: 繁荣；经济上成功和富足的状态。
senses.exampleEn: Education can contribute to a country's prosperity.
senses.exampleZh: 教育可以促进一个国家的繁荣。

senses.en: Control that prevents excessive action or emotion.
senses.zh: 克制；对行为或情绪的控制。
senses.exampleEn: The speaker showed restraint despite the angry comments.
senses.exampleZh: 面对愤怒的评论，发言人仍保持克制。

senses.en: Present or noticeable throughout a place or society.
senses.zh: 普遍的；遍布某处或某个社会的。
senses.exampleEn: Digital technology has a pervasive influence on daily life.
senses.exampleZh: 数字技术对日常生活有广泛影响。

senses.en: To make a sound, effect, or problem stronger.
senses.zh: 增强；放大声音、影响或问题。
senses.exampleEn: Social media can amplify a small disagreement.
senses.exampleZh: 社交媒体可能放大一个小小的分歧。

senses.en: A legal right that protects an invention.
senses.zh: 专利；保护发明的法律权利。
senses.exampleEn: The researcher applied for a patent for the new device.
senses.exampleZh: 研究者为这个新装置申请了专利。

senses.en: To separate something so that it can be examined.
senses.zh: 分离；将某物单独分开以便研究。
senses.exampleEn: Scientists isolate the molecule before testing it.
senses.exampleZh: 科学家在测试前先分离该分子。

senses.en: Allowing many kinds of people to take part.
senses.zh: 包容的；允许不同人群参与的。
senses.exampleEn: An inclusive classroom helps every student feel welcome.
senses.exampleZh: 包容的课堂让每个学生都感到被接纳。

senses.en: To change the form or character of something.
senses.zh: 重塑；改变形态或性质。
senses.exampleEn: New technology may reshape the way people work.
senses.exampleZh: 新技术可能重塑人们的工作方式。

senses.en: A person who comes to live in another country.
senses.zh: 移民；到另一个国家定居的人。
senses.exampleEn: The immigrant opened a small shop in her new neighborhood.
senses.exampleZh: 这位移民在她的新社区开了一家小店。

senses.en: To grow, develop, or succeed strongly.
senses.zh: 繁荣；茁壮成长；发展良好。
senses.exampleEn: Small businesses thrive when local demand grows.
senses.exampleZh: 当地需求增长时，小企业会蓬勃发展。

senses.en: Likely to suffer from or do something undesirable.
senses.zh: 易于遭受或做出某种不利行为的。
senses.exampleEn: People are prone to mistakes when they rush.
senses.exampleZh: 人们匆忙时容易犯错。

senses.en: A sudden desire to do something.
senses.zh: 冲动；突然产生的行动欲望。
senses.exampleEn: She resisted the impulse to buy another pair of shoes.
senses.exampleZh: 她克制了再买一双鞋的冲动。

senses.en: Related to a company or a group of companies.
senses.zh: 公司的；企业的。
senses.exampleEn: The report examines corporate responsibility for pollution.
senses.exampleZh: 这份报告探讨了企业对污染应承担的责任。

senses.en: Creating an obligation that must be followed.
senses.zh: 有约束力的；使人必须遵守的。
senses.exampleEn: The agreement becomes binding after both sides sign it.
senses.exampleZh: 双方签字后，该协议便具有约束力。

senses.en: A woman whose spouse has died and who has not remarried.
senses.zh: 寡妇；配偶去世后尚未再婚的女性。
senses.exampleEn: The widow continued to manage the family business.
senses.exampleZh: 这位寡妇继续经营家族生意。

senses.en: To become visible or known.
senses.zh: 出现；开始显现或被认知。
senses.exampleEn: A clearer picture began to emerge from the evidence.
senses.exampleZh: 随着证据出现，事情逐渐变得清晰。

senses.en: To move or develop more slowly than someone or something.
senses.zh: 落后；进展更慢。
senses.exampleEn: Rural internet access may lag behind that of cities.
senses.exampleZh: 农村的互联网接入可能落后于城市。

senses.en: Money given for a particular purpose, often study or research.
senses.zh: 拨款；常用于学习或研究的资助。
senses.exampleEn: The student received a grant to continue her research.
senses.exampleZh: 这位学生获得了一笔资助，以继续研究。

senses.en: A language used by people with different first languages.
senses.zh: 通用语；不同母语的人之间使用的共同语言。
senses.exampleEn: English often serves as a lingua franca at international meetings.
senses.exampleZh: 在国际会议上，英语常用作通用语。

senses.en: Loyalty to a person, organization, or belief.
senses.zh: 忠诚；对个人、组织或信念的拥护。
senses.exampleEn: Their allegiance to the organization remained strong.
senses.exampleZh: 他们对该组织仍然十分忠诚。

senses.en: Good enough in quality or standard.
senses.zh: 相当好的；达到合适标准的。
senses.exampleEn: Everyone deserves a decent place to live.
senses.exampleZh: 每个人都应有一个条件不错的住所。

senses.en: To fail to notice or consider something.
senses.zh: 忽略；没有注意或考虑到。
senses.exampleEn: Do not overlook the small details in the report.
senses.exampleZh: 不要忽略报告中的小细节。

senses.en: The activity of writing instructions for computers.
senses.zh: 编程；为计算机编写指令的活动。
senses.exampleEn: The school introduced coding to help students solve problems.
senses.exampleZh: 学校引入编程，帮助学生解决问题。

senses.en: Completely necessary for something.
senses.zh: 必不可少的；至关重要的。
senses.exampleEn: Regular practice is essential for lasting improvement.
senses.exampleZh: 规律练习对于持续进步至关重要。

senses.en: The process of working together toward a shared goal.
senses.zh: 合作；为共同目标一起工作的过程。
senses.exampleEn: The project succeeded through close collaboration between teams.
senses.exampleZh: 项目通过团队之间的密切合作取得了成功。

senses.en: The natural place where a plant or animal lives.
senses.zh: 栖息地；动植物自然生活的环境。
senses.exampleEn: Protecting the wetland helps preserve the birds' habitat.
senses.exampleZh: 保护湿地有助于保留鸟类的栖息地。

senses.en: Making someone feel deeply involved in an experience.
senses.zh: 沉浸式的；使人深入投入某种体验的。
senses.exampleEn: The museum created an immersive exhibition about ancient cities.
senses.exampleZh: 博物馆打造了一个关于古代城市的沉浸式展览。

senses.en: Difficult and complicated to deal with.
senses.zh: 棘手的；难以处理且复杂的。
senses.exampleEn: The committee must address several thorny questions.
senses.exampleZh: 委员会必须处理几个棘手的问题。

senses.en: The setting or background against which something happens.
senses.zh: 背景；事件发生的环境。
senses.exampleEn: The debate took place against a backdrop of economic uncertainty.
senses.exampleZh: 这场辩论是在经济不确定的背景下展开的。

senses.en: To move toward the same point or become more similar.
senses.zh: 汇聚；趋于一致。
senses.exampleEn: The two teams' ideas began to converge after the discussion.
senses.exampleZh: 讨论后，两个团队的想法开始趋于一致。

senses.en: The shared values and spirit of a group.
senses.zh: 精神特质；群体共同的价值观与理念。
senses.exampleEn: Fair play is central to the ethos of the sports club.
senses.exampleZh: 公平竞争是这家体育俱乐部理念的核心。

senses.en: To provide an organization with workers.
senses.zh: 为某个组织配备工作人员。
senses.exampleEn: Volunteers staff the information desk during the event.
senses.exampleZh: 活动期间，志愿者在咨询台工作。

senses.en: A serious mistake caused by carelessness or poor judgment.
senses.zh: 大错；因粗心或判断不当造成的错误。
senses.exampleEn: Ignoring the warning was a costly blunder.
senses.exampleZh: 忽视警告是一个代价高昂的错误。

senses.en: Existing as a basic part of something.
senses.zh: 固有的；内在的。
senses.exampleEn: Every investment carries an inherent risk.
senses.exampleZh: 每项投资都带有内在风险。

senses.en: A large uncontrolled fire in a natural area.
senses.zh: 野火；自然区域内失控的大火。
senses.exampleEn: The wildfire spread quickly through the dry forest.
senses.exampleZh: 野火在干燥的森林中迅速蔓延。

senses.en: The visible natural features of an area.
senses.zh: 地貌；一个地区可见的自然景观。
senses.exampleEn: The river has shaped the landscape over many years.
senses.exampleZh: 多年来，这条河流塑造了当地的地貌。

senses.en: To give a good reason for an action or belief.
senses.zh: 证明有道理；为行为或观点提供合理理由。
senses.exampleEn: The evidence does not justify such a strong conclusion.
senses.exampleZh: 这些证据不足以支持如此强烈的结论。

senses.en: To disappear gradually, or turn from liquid into gas.
senses.zh: 逐渐消失；或由液体变成气体。
senses.exampleEn: Their hopes began to evaporate as costs increased.
senses.exampleZh: 随着成本增加，他们的希望开始逐渐消失。

senses.en: To make an event happen sooner.
senses.zh: 加速；促使事情更早发生。
senses.exampleEn: The new policy may hasten the transition to clean energy.
senses.exampleZh: 新政策可能加速向清洁能源的转型。

senses.en: A long period with little or no rain.
senses.zh: 干旱；长时间缺少降雨的时期。
senses.exampleEn: The drought reduced the region's food production.
senses.exampleZh: 干旱使该地区的粮食产量下降。

senses.en: Sensitive to or aware of something.
senses.zh: 敏锐的；对某事有所意识并能作出响应的。
senses.exampleEn: Good teachers are attuned to their students' needs.
senses.exampleZh: 好的教师对学生的需求很敏锐。

senses.en: To recognize or establish what something is.
senses.zh: 识别；确定某物是什么。
senses.exampleEn: The study aims to identify the causes of the problem.
senses.exampleZh: 这项研究旨在找出问题的原因。

senses.en: To find and employ new people.
senses.zh: 招募；聘用新的人员。
senses.exampleEn: The company plans to recruit more engineers this year.
senses.exampleZh: 公司计划今年招聘更多工程师。

senses.en: Mainly; more than anything else.
senses.zh: 主要地；以某种因素为主。
senses.exampleEn: The program is funded principally by local donations.
senses.exampleZh: 这个项目主要由当地捐款资助。

senses.en: To live in or occupy a place.
senses.zh: 居住于；占据某个地方。
senses.exampleEn: Several rare species inhabit this forest.
senses.exampleZh: 几种珍稀物种栖息在这片森林中。

senses.en: Existing beneath the surface and helping explain something.
senses.zh: 根本的；潜在的；表面现象背后的。
senses.exampleEn: The report explores the underlying causes of inequality.
senses.exampleZh: 报告探讨了不平等背后的根本原因。

senses.en: Learning new skills so that one can do a different kind of work.
senses.zh: 再培训；为从事不同工作而学习新技能。
senses.exampleEn: Reskilling can help workers adapt to technological change.
senses.exampleZh: 再培训可以帮助劳动者适应技术变化。

senses.en: Something that is needed or must be done.
senses.zh: 要求；必须满足的必要条件。
senses.exampleEn: Work experience is a requirement for this position.
senses.exampleZh: 工作经验是这个岗位的必要条件。

senses.en: To predict what is likely to happen.
senses.zh: 预测；预报可能发生的事情。
senses.exampleEn: Analysts forecast a rise in demand next year.
senses.exampleZh: 分析人士预测明年需求会增长。

senses.en: To have the greatest power or influence in a situation.
senses.zh: 主导；占据支配或统治地位。
senses.exampleEn: A few large firms dominate the market.
senses.exampleZh: 少数几家大型企业主导着市场。

senses.en: To move around freely without a fixed destination.
senses.zh: 漫步；没有固定目的地地自由走动。
senses.exampleEn: Visitors can roam through the gardens at their own pace.
senses.exampleZh: 游客可以按自己的节奏在花园里漫步。

senses.en: To refuse to consider an idea as important or reasonable.
senses.zh: 不屑一顾；拒绝认真考虑某个观点。
senses.exampleEn: We should not dismiss the concerns of local residents.
senses.exampleZh: 我们不应对当地居民的担忧不屑一顾。

senses.en: The time or state of stopping regular work, usually because of age.
senses.zh: 退休；通常因年龄而停止日常工作的阶段。
senses.exampleEn: She plans to travel after retirement.
senses.exampleZh: 她计划退休后去旅行。

senses.en: All the people available for or employed in work.
senses.zh: 劳动力；可工作或受雇工作的全部人员。
senses.exampleEn: The company is investing in training its workforce.
senses.exampleZh: 公司正在投入资金培训员工队伍。

senses.en: To meet someone or experience a difficulty unexpectedly.
senses.zh: 遇到；意外碰到某人或困难。
senses.exampleEn: New users may encounter problems with the complex menu.
senses.exampleZh: 新用户可能会在复杂菜单上遇到问题。

senses.en: Easy to understand or use without much instruction.
senses.zh: 直观的；无需大量说明就容易理解或使用的。
senses.exampleEn: An intuitive design makes the app easier to use.
senses.exampleZh: 直观的设计让这个应用更容易使用。

senses.en: A long or determined search for something.
senses.zh: 追求；对某物持续或坚定的探寻。
senses.exampleEn: The quest for cleaner energy requires cooperation.
senses.exampleZh: 寻求更清洁的能源需要合作。

senses.en: A misleading appearance of environmental responsibility.
senses.zh: 环保幌子；虚假的环保形象。
senses.exampleEn: The report questions whether the campaign is merely greenwash.
senses.exampleZh: 报告质疑这场宣传是否只是环保幌子。

senses.en: To introduce a product or service to the market.
senses.zh: 推出；将产品或服务投放市场。
senses.exampleEn: The company will launch a new learning platform next month.
senses.exampleZh: 公司将在下个月推出新的学习平台。

senses.en: Work done to keep something in good condition.
senses.zh: 维护；保养；使某物保持良好状态的工作。
senses.exampleEn: Regular maintenance keeps the equipment working safely.
senses.exampleZh: 定期维护能确保设备安全运行。

senses.en: To direct a group or guide an activity.
senses.zh: 领导；指挥；引导某项活动。
senses.exampleEn: She will lead the team through the difficult project.
senses.exampleZh: 她将带领团队完成这个困难的项目。

senses.en: A heavy soft grey metal, pronounced differently from the verb.
senses.zh: 铅；一种柔软的灰色重金属，读音与动词不同。
senses.exampleEn: Old pipes sometimes contain lead.
senses.exampleZh: 旧管道有时含铅。

senses.en: To describe a past habit or state that is no longer true.
senses.zh: 曾经做某事；表示过去的习惯或状态。
senses.exampleEn: She used to walk to work before she moved.
senses.exampleZh: 搬家以前，她曾经步行上班。

senses.en: To deal successfully with a difficult situation.
senses.zh: 应对；有效处理困难局面。
senses.exampleEn: The city must cope with increasingly hot summers.
senses.exampleZh: 这座城市必须应对越来越炎热的夏天。

senses.en: To make up a particular share of a total.
senses.zh: 占；构成总量中的某个比例。
senses.exampleEn: Rail journeys account for a third of all trips.
senses.exampleZh: 铁路出行占全部出行的三分之一。

senses.en: To explain the reason for something.
senses.zh: 解释；说明某事的原因。
senses.exampleEn: Several factors account for the change in demand.
senses.exampleZh: 几个因素解释了需求变化的原因。

senses.en: To move away from something or avoid involvement in it.
senses.zh: 从……后退；避免参与某事。
senses.exampleEn: Some investors back away from risky projects.
senses.exampleZh: 一些投资者对风险项目避而远之。

senses.en: To take a shorter route instead of following the full path.
senses.zh: 抄近路；不沿完整路线行走。
senses.exampleEn: Visitors cut corners by walking across the lawn.
senses.exampleZh: 游客穿过草坪来抄近路。

senses.en: To leave out necessary steps to save time or money.
senses.zh: 偷工减料；为节省时间或金钱省略必要步骤。
senses.exampleEn: Builders should not cut corners on safety.
senses.exampleZh: 建筑施工人员不应在安全问题上偷工减料。
